## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: strong cross‑sector breadth yet clear megacap divergences (INTU BELOW TREND, NVDA CORRECTION, GOOGL CORRECTION) and mixed news flow, so no decisive risk tilt; Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Tech & Consumer).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials weak: DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND. Industrials lagging pockets: DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND. Energy trailing versus peers: XOM (1W: -1.90% | 1M: +3.61%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Tech & Consumer); Style: Growth/Momentum tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND, DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, NEE (1W: -5.15% | 1M: -8.00%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select high‑beta and cyclical names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
1W leaders: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND — note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple megacaps (NVDA, GOOGL, MSFT, INTU) show 1W vs 1M mismatch, so treat momentum moves as tactical.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed: AAPL (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND — sector strength but headline megacap fatigue; Sector breadth: part of the 10/11 positive sectors.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Cautious constructive: V (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +6.70%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +0.88% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY — Financials broadly positive inside the neutral regime.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing upside: LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +1.60%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +9.56%) CORRECTION — defensive stance but pockets of strength from drug catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective growth/momentum names (QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND) and high‑quality healthcare (LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to stocks showing exhaustion (INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION). Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but watch concentration risks and megacap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Utilities (VST RECOVERY) and Consumer Discretionary (F ABOVE TREND, ROST ABOVE TREND) on momentum. BEARISH: Materials (DOW BELOW TREND) and select Industrials (DE BELOW TREND) as downside risk areas.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION — watch reclaim of the recent weekly pivot for trend confirmation. AAPL (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND — hold above monthly support to keep trend intact. QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND — a sustained move above this week’s high signals continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
MRK (+60): MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND — CHMP backing Keytruda combo and price confirming sentiment. AMD (+55): AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND — positive coverage and price accumulation confirm. JPM (+60): JPM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY — regulatory clearance bullish but watch follow‑through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
GOOGL (-50): GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION — EU fine headlines align with short‑term price weakness. TTWO (-50): TTWO (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION — cautious outlook news and price pullback are confirming.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given strong tech and consumer leadership but broad sector participation. QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: megacap divergences and mixed news sentiment (GOOGL, NVDA, INTU) — monitor for trend breaks before scaling core exposure.
